definitions.explanation: The body of laws governing taxation, or any individual statute within that body. Used in legal, accounting, and government contexts.

examples.japanese: {税法|ぜいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{税法|ぜいほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}になる→楽になる：26083_rakuninaru⟧。
examples.english: Having knowledge of tax law makes filing tax returns easier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{税法|ぜいほう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧だ。
examples.english: Tax law changes in detail every year, so it's reassuring to consult a specialist.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (tax) + ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (law). Used both as a general term for the area of law and as a generic reference to specific tax statutes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税法|ぜいほう}⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧: tax-law revision
- {税法|ぜいほう}⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧: tax-law violation
- {税法|ぜいほう}{上|じょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: treatment under tax law
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{税法|ぜいほう}: international tax law

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{税制|ぜいせい}→税制：28854_zeisei⟧: tax system — broader, refers to the overall structure of taxation, not the statutes themselves
- ⟦{税務|ぜいむ}→税務：30025_zeimu⟧: tax matters; tax affairs — administrative side (⟦{税務署|ぜいむしょ}→税務署：13782_zeimusho⟧ 'tax office')
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧: law (general) — the general word; {税法|ぜいほう} is one branch
